about: Hand labels for the desktop on Chat Computer's own model (Qwen3.5 0.8B at medium effort, the smallest the app picks, for computers with under 4 GB), one case per area, before the fixes of 4 November 2026 (run os-base: Chat Computer at 0e468cb's parent, with the prompt already read). pass = what the person asked for got done, or an honest answer with a way forward. modes: the failures seen, the first first.

files-find-open.note: found the letter and showed its words as a document; said nothing

usb-whats-on.note: opened the drive by its path, not its name; looked at the folder with Read, Glob and ls (Photos, Recipes.docx), and never said so in 10 minutes

print-boarding-pass.note: printed with the path's home folder left out, again and again; printed the tax letter instead; showed Downloads 30 times; no answer in 10 minutes

wifi-join.note: joined "CoffeeBean wifi": the network is CoffeeBean (the simulated computer took any name)

dark-mode.note: set the brightness to 100% and said dark mode is on (the screen is always dark)

lock-screen.note: the PIN form, as the tool said

weather.note: no forecast to be had here (web search can't reach the internet in this sandbox); tried a US weather site, showed a page of its own making, and never answered
